build_PAA_detector: build a PAA single-stage detector with backbone, neck, and bbox_head config modules
run_PAA_loss: run the PAA detector loss computation on a batch of input images and data samples
run_PAA_predict: run the PAA detector predict method to get bounding box predictions from input images
run_PAA_extract_feat: run the PAA detector extract_feat method to get multi-level features from input images
review_PAA_init: review the PAA detector __init__ to understand backbone, neck, and bbox_head initialization
